description: Source code for the DataCapture plugin in the WPEFramework, handling audio capture sessions, event handling, and data upload via cURL.

classes.name: DataCapture
classes.description: Main class implementing audio data capture, event handling, and data upload functionalities.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin and IARM communication.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin and unregisters IARM event handlers.

methods.name: enableAudioCapture
methods.description: Starts or stops audio capture sessions based on buffer duration.

methods.name: getAudioClip
methods.description: Requests an audio clip with specified parameters and uploads it.

methods.name: uploadDataToUrl
methods.description: Uploads captured audio data to a specified URL using cURL.
